character: The Myoko area's highest ski resort, on the slopes of Mt. Myoko in Niigata, operated by Prince Hotels. It is known for its 8.5 km longest run and over 1,100 m of vertical.
learning: 40% of courses are rated beginner (search summary); elementary-school-age children and younger ski free. Reference, confirm: ski school and rentals operate at the base.

transfers.name: Hokuriku Shinkansen to Nagano, then rail/bus to Myoko Kogen
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Hokuriku Shinkansen from Tokyo to Nagano (about 1.5 h), then the Shinano Railway Kita-Shinano line to Myoko-Kogen station and a bus or taxi to Suginohara; or the Shinkansen to Joetsu-Myoko and a road transfer. Check 2026-27 timetables and fares.
